ritual: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent overhead ritual marking for a dark gothic painted dungeon game. A single complete circular summoning sigil drawn in dark vermilion pigment, seen perfectly vertically from above, with fine worn painted strokes and subtle ember-red highlights. Inside is an angular four-point diamond and sparse arcane scratches. Four clearly readable empty circular candle sockets at the north, east, south and west, centered at 17%, 50%, 83% of the square along their axes. The ring connects those four sockets. No candles are present. Transparent background including the entire interior; no floor, slab, pedestal, shadow, text or border. Perfectly circular, centered, fills the square with 6% transparent margin. This will be split over a 3 by 3 tile area, so cardinal sockets must be centered in the middle outer tiles. Original painterly game art, crisp at small scale, no pixel art.
props: Original painted dark gothic dungeon game prop sheet, transparent background, exactly four equally sized panels in a 2 by 2 grid with wide empty transparent gutters. Top left: a straight stretch of two parallel iron mine rails on wooden sleepers, viewed exactly from overhead, rails run vertically from the top edge of its panel to the bottom edge, no perspective convergence, no ground, no border or platform. Top right: a rectangular continuous row of ancient leather books on two dark wooden shelf planks, seen front on, books fill the entire width, perfectly straight horizontal shelf planks running edge to edge, no freestanding cabinet or side posts, no background. Bottom left: a squat ominous wooden worktable seen from high above in dungeon game perspective, crimson cloth and a few scattered bones, four small legs, no candles, no floor. Bottom right: a squat blacksmith stone furnace seen from high above in dungeon game perspective, glowing orange coals in its front opening, soot black iron hood, warm grey stone, no floor. Sharp readable silhouettes, rich weathered hand-painted materials, restrained highlights, no pixel art, no text, no cast shadows outside objects. Keep all four objects separated.
pipeline: Committed authored PNGs, offline crop/scale/atlas composition only. Layout contracts pinned to v4.0.0. No network or image generation during builds.
